title: Ultimate Aflatoxin Binder

sections.heading: Ultimate Aflatoxin Binder
sections.text: Aflatoxins present in cattle feed are a significant hazard, affecting animal health and compromising the safety of dairy products. Regulatory limits are stringent due to the carcinogenic risks of aflatoxin contamination in milk and meat. Ultimate Aflatoxin Binder employs a dual-action formulation featuring hydrated sodium calcium alumino silicates (HSCAS) and a natural acid blend. This combination selectively adsorbs aflatoxins thereby reducing toxin levels to within safe regulatory limits. Components Hydrated Sodium Calcium Alumino Silicates (HSCAS) with Natural Organic Acid Blend.

sections.heading: Components
sections.text: Hydrated Sodium Calcium Alumino Silicates (HSCAS) with Natural Organic Acid Blend. Key Features Selective Adsorption: High surface area and optimized cation exchange capacity for effective aflatoxin binding. Nutrient Preservation: Ensures that essential nutrients are not sequestered during the detoxification process.
